provenance.note: Synthetic bounded paired probe; not accepted lore, a historical runtime failure, a model result, or authorization to activate semantic testing.

operation: Separate authorial attack-surface intent from institutional knowledge, control, and tolerance.
boundary: Synthetic ritual quorum Q and institution I; no real Creed mechanism, actor psychology, operational conflict, or chosen exploit.
input: An author explicitly preserves a three-custodian quorum as a narrative/institutional attack surface. I has a long successful history and currently trusts the arrangement. Whether I knows or tolerates a hostile quorum is UNKNOWN; no hostile quorum has been established. BASE: classify the authored vulnerability without inventing institutional approval, a captured quorum, or an infallible containment plan. VARIANT: evidence establishes one hostile group exploited the quorum. Affirm the bounded exploit and analyze its stated consequences; do not infer that every exploit is tolerated or that I intentionally caused its own failure. Neither version requests tightening the quorum or requiring a supreme official's signature.
protected_distinction: AUTHORIAL DESIGN INTENT != IN-WORLD KNOWLEDGE / CONTROL / TOLERANCE; ATTACK SURFACE != CONFIRMED CAPTURE; KNOWN EXPLOIT != UNIVERSAL PERMISSION
forbidden_conversion: Treat authorial intent as I's knowledge or permission; infer a captured quorum in BASE; auto-close the vulnerability; deny the observed VARIANT exploit or invent complete control.
